info.title: Medical Bill Fighter
info.description: Qull Connect API. Supply a per-user API key in Authorization: Bearer <key>. Keys identify one customer; arbitrary platform/user-id headers are not accepted. Payment setup opens hosted Stripe Checkout and does not charge a service fee. Use the record's billing/status operation to verify setup, then explicitly authorize the applicable fee. See the linked guide for workflow and service limits.

201.description: Creates a bill review with possible issues for provider/insurer review. Findings do not prove a billing error.

example.user_message: I went through your $500 bill and flagged 1 thing(s) to discuss with your provider or insurer. These flags do not establish an error. Would you like a letter template?

findings.explanation: Code 99213 at $250.00 appears 2 times (lines [1, 2]). This may indicate the same charge was billed more than once.
findings.suggested_action: Ask the provider to confirm whether the service was actually performed multiple times; if not, request removal of the duplicate charge(s).

findings.explanation: For this $500.00 balance, you can ask whether the provider offers payment assistance or a discount. No discount is promised. This is a discussion opportunity, not a billing error.
findings.suggested_action: Use the negotiation script pack to ask the billing department about a prompt-pay discount before paying the full amount.
